item.frontierhunts.jerry_can.tip_empty: Empty. Draw a lava source into it (or craft it with a lava bucket) - the heat cracks it to fuel.
item.frontierhunts.jerry_can.tip: Use on an ATV to pour (hold to keep pouring). Rides in the ATV can carrier as reserve fuel.
item.frontierhunts.atv_cargo_box.tip: Use on an ATV to fit it to the rear rack (27 slots). Sneak-use the ATV to open.
item.frontierhunts.atv_can_carrier.tip: Bolts to the rear rack rails: two strapped jerry cans.
item.frontierhunts.atv_can_carrier.tip2: Cans on the rack refill the tank automatically when it runs dry.
gui.frontierhunts.atv_rig.pour.tip: Top up the tank from the jerry cans on the rack and in the box.
gui.frontierhunts.atv_rig.unstrap.tip: Take the cargo box off the rack. Everything inside stays packed in it.
gui.frontierhunts.atv_rig.unbolt.tip: Unbolt the can carrier; the cans come with it.
gui.frontierhunts.atv_rig.no_box2: Use an ATV Cargo Box on the ATV
message.frontierhunts.atv_out_of_fuel: The engine sputters and dies - out of gas.
message.frontierhunts.atv_no_fuel: The starter turns but nothing catches - the tank is empty.
message.frontierhunts.atv_reserve_auto: Tank ran dry - poured %s L in from the reserve cans
message.frontierhunts.atv_no_rig: Nothing on the rack - fit an ATV Cargo Box or Can Carrier
message.frontierhunts.atv_box_fitted: Cargo box strapped to the rear rack
message.frontierhunts.atv_carrier_fitted: Can carrier bolted to the rear rack
message.frontierhunts.jerry_can_filled: Filled the can: %s L of fuel
item.frontierhunts.atv.tip2: Runs on gasoline - pour it in from a jerry can. Sneak and right-click it for the rear rack; sneak and hit it to pick it up (fuel stays in the tank). Grip depends on the ground: careful on ice, mud and powder.
